newsitem.title: DUBAI: Oman receives $18.7 mln loan from Abu Dhabi.
newsitem.headline: Oman receives $18.7 mln loan from Abu Dhabi.

text.p: Oman on Wednesday received a 68.5 million dirham ($18.7 million) loan from the Abu Dhabi Development Fund to finance a fishing port project in Sur, eastern Oman, the official WAM news agency said.
The loan, at three percent interest plus half-a-percent in administrative costs, extends over a period of 10 years, the agency said. It gave no details of the project.

WAM said the fund had also signed a letter of understanding with Oman's finance ministry approving a grant of $100 million to finance the completion of a dual carriageway road at Nizwa, about 150 km (93 miles) southwest of the capital Muscat in the country's interior. ($1=3.67 dirhams)
